about: What the VU 5.4 client does with each item class, keyed by class; an item's class is the high 16 bits of its client-5.4 key (key = class * 65536 + index). From petest's Tools/arkinventory.py catalogue, every field READ from the client except where said. tabs: the inventory window's category pages the class is filed under, 9 Weapons, 10 Armor, 11 Clothes, 12 Tools, 13 Food, 14 Meds, 15 Material+Money, 16 Docs (731 ItemBelongsOnPage). stackable: the class descends from 5555, whose GetAmount is the count the icon prints, so an item is an amount rather than one object. icon: how the client gets the icon (the first path through dyn_994a4c1e): kind render (drawn from the model at runtime), table (one stored texture per texture variant, 343 +0x10, which the server held per item) or constant (one stored texture); width and height the icon's size in pixels, 0 where the class declares none; textures the stored texture ids. condition_bar: the class's ShowsConditionBar, whether its inventory row shows a condition bar. The Item Info window 1170's choices by class: value_line (value, market for Market Value, balance for the account balance), condition_meter (whether it shows the Condition meter) and stats (the Stats pane's sections in order: tool, armour, weapon, blueprint, nostats, container). Not shown on the page.
